name: VCSL Mbira dzaVadzimu
description: Recorded Zimbabwean mbira dzaVadzimu in the Nyamaropa tuning, with its characteristic metallic tine attack and alternate takes.

This is the Nyamaropa-tuned mbira dzaVadzimu in low B. The source's two B3 and two C#4 tines remain separate alternate takes for those pitches.
